scope.chapter: Adhyaya XVIII, appended extract from Satyacharya

Aries.sanskrit_iast: (not in the mula; Aiyar prints this as an extract from Satyachariar's work on horoscopy, not as Varahamihira's own text)
Aries.engine_rendering: Disfigured fingers, of irascible temper, bringing on enmity, acting inconsistently with his views, of bilious and windy temperament, a niggard, suffering grief; separated when young from his parents and his preceptor; foolish sons; assisting his brothers and kinsmen; virtuous, travelling to foreign lands, engaging in useless work; marrying a woman of low caste, or a deceitful woman, or one of defective limbs, or one already married; obtaining friendly relations. Death by weapons, poison, bilious complaints, the people about him, fire, rain, imprisonment or a fall.
